title: Category registry
description: catalog/categories.json — the single source of truth for category identity. Before this existed, a category was declared in three places (products/*.json filenames, CATEGORIES_DICT in scripts.js, data-category in index.html) and only two of the three were cross-checked.

aliases.description: Retired slug -> current slug. Keeps an existing #hash deep link resolving after a rename.

nav.description: The navigation tree, in display order.

leaf.description: A selectable category backed by exactly one products/{slug}.json file.

label.description: Heading text, also used in the WhatsApp message. What CATEGORIES_DICT used to hold.

navLabel.description: Nav button text. Shorter than label, because the nav supplies context — 'Bonés' under Masculino/Acessórios, versus the 'Bonés Masculino' heading.

imageDir.description: Directory holding this category's images. Derived from gender/category/subcategory today, but stated explicitly so the tree can be reorganised without a schema change.

usesBrandFolders.description: When true, a branded product's image sits one level deeper, in a folder named for its brand slug. Brandless products always sit directly in imageDir — that holds for all 6 brandless products today, and is what makes shorts-jeans-man's apparently mixed shape regular.

group.description: A nav-only node. Must never have a products file: clicking it toggles its submenu rather than rendering.

generated.description: A category whose contents the build generates rather than reading from a hand-edited file — currently only `all`.
